premises.text: Bicycle theft is massive and current locks and trackers are not integrated into a truly smart lock
premises.evidence_span: Bicycle theft is a huge problem worldwide

premises.text: Lock8 combines alarm, security sensors, GPS tracking, and keyless unlocking in one lock
premises.evidence_span: It has to have an alarm. It has to be secure. And it has to be GPS trackable

premises.text: App enables arming, tamper push alerts, locating the lock, notification channels, and sensitivity settings
premises.evidence_span: if my thief tries to tamper with it, it switches on the alarm. And I will shortly get a push notification

premises.text: Users can share or rent bikes/locks for connected mobility without city bike-share infrastructure
premises.evidence_span: we can share bikes easily with anyone that we want

domains.name: bike theft and weak security tech

value.text: Bike owners keep bikes safe and can share or rent them with confidence
value.evidence_span: you can rent your bike out to whoever you want, and you can rest assured that your bike will be safe

causal_links.evidence_span: bike security tech today is not that advanced
using incredible technology inside the device, as well as a really advanced app
truly disrupt what bicycle sharing is all about
